Name: Dried Flowers Dehydrator
Author: cardiacman
Description:
[b][color=#d4d4d8]Description[/color][/b]
[color=#D4D4D8]Give your flowers another use! Turn five matching flowers into a dried flower using the Dehydrator you already know.
[/color]
[color=#D4D4D8][b]Installation instructions[/b]
[/color]
[list=1]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Install SMAPI and Content Patcher.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Download and unzip this mod.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Place the
[/color]
[code]Dried Flowers Dehydrator[/code][color=#D4D4D8]folder inside your
[/color]
[code]Stardew Valley/Mods[/code][color=#D4D4D8]folder.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Launch the game through SMAPI and pop five matching flowers into a Dehydrator.[/color][/*]
[/list][color=#D4D4D8]You can use an existing save. For multiplayer, all players should install the mod.
[/color]
[color=#D4D4D8][b]Main features[/b]
[/color]
[list]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Turn five matching flowers into one dried flower.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Works with vanilla flowers and correctly categorised or tagged modded flowers, including Mount Vapius flowers.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Uses the usual dried fruit processing time and pricing.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Keeps your existing fruit and mushroom recipes working as usual.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]No extra machines or crafting recipes needed.[/color][/*]
[/list][color=#D4D4D8][b]Requirements[/b]
[/color]
[list]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Stardew Valley 1.6.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]SMAPI.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Content Patcher 2.9.0 or later.[/color][/*]
[/list][color=#D4D4D8] Custom flowers need the flower category or
[/color]
[code]flower_item[/code][color=#D4D4D8]tag to work automatically.
[/color]
[color=#D4D4D8][b]Shout outs[/b]
Thanks to ConcernedApe for Stardew Valley, Pathoschild and the contributors behind SMAPI and Content Patcher, and the Stardew modding community for their helpful documentation.[/color]
